description: Upright between the bars, M8 core thread at both ends, the bottom one extra deep (80 mm)
Top bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns; 4 through holes 8.5 with 14 mm counterbore
Bottom bar, 60 high, front and back, one piece over all three columns; carries the middle uprights between the corner castors; 4 through holes 8.5
Depth beam between the front and the back bar, top and bottom, under or over each upright
Level 1 support, flat leg at the bottom on the bottom bars
Level 2-5 support, flat leg on top, hanging leg guides the box below
Tip guard above level 5, same section and orientation as angle.support
Inside angle bracket 30 for B-type slot 8: upright to depth beam (16) and depth beam to bar (16)
Inside angle bracket 30 as the back stop, two per box on the back uprights
L connector plate 90x90x4, 5 holes, at the four corner joints of the front and the back frame, top and bottom
T connector plate 90x90x4, 5 holes, at the middle uprights of the front and the back frame, top and bottom
ISO 7380 M6x12 for the brackets: 2 per bracket.inside_30, 1 per bracket.stop
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M6x10 for the joint plates
Hammer nut M6 B-type slot 8 for the brackets and the plates
ISO 10642 M5x10 for the angles, flush in a countersunk hole so the hanging leg stays smooth
Hammer nut M5 B-type slot 8 for the angles
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x100 through the bottom bar into an upright; at the corners through the castor as well
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x50 through the top bar into an upright, head sunk in the counterbore
ISO 7093 washer 8.4 under the head in the castor's back hole
Swivel castor 125 mm with total lock and back hole, 100 kg, under a front corner
Swivel castor 125 mm with back hole, 100 kg, under a back corner
Self-adhesive UHMW-PE slide tape on the flat legs that carry boxes
End cap 30x30 for the ends of the top bars
End cap 30x60 for the ends of the bottom bars
Slot cover strip for the top faces of the top bars and the top depth beams
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x120, open handles, anthracite (C2O43-12)
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x220, open handles, anthracite (C2O43-22), no inserts
ColorClip set red, 2 rings (R200-00-01-SET), level 1
ColorClip set turquoise, 2 rings (R200-00-12-SET), level 2
ColorClip set purple, 2 rings (R200-00-15-SET), level 3
ColorClip set yellow, 2 rings (R200-00-03-SET), level 4
ColorClip set blue, 2 rings (R200-00-02-SET), level 5
Insert set 1/2 for 400x300x120 (EES43-01-100-04): 2 x NextGen 3613-100
Insert set 1/4 for 400x300x120 (EES43-02-100-04): 4 x NextGen 1813-100
Top plate, birch plywood, corners rounded R25
Angle bracket 30 with fixing set, swung into the top bars' inner slots
Wood screw 4.5x12, pan head, from below through the brackets
